blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and tighten the rhythm playing.

blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of a dedicated OD pedal to keep the tone extremely clean and bright, matching 'Fender Twin' clues.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, bright sound of a Fender Twin/American Deluxe setup.
Provide a bright, articulate, and focused clean tone suitable for funk rhythms.
Enhance the high-end sparkle and cut out excessive low-mid mud.

blocks.gap: The target is very dry/percussive, so reverb must be kept minimal to maintain tightness.

improvements.summary: The current IR is good but could be optimized for maximum percussive clarity and brightness required by disco-funk.
